purpose: Constrain one complete candidate using current T, exact native semantics and original stored train-side derivatives.
interpretation_limits: No unique performance root cause identified.
No candidate implementation or trained performance result.
A gradient energy is not missing information or necessity of task-conditional A.
Horizon geometry does not identify meaningful action semantics.
No new Test or shuffled/reversed evidence used for design.

native_horizon_geometry.scope: Eight existing train-only self_read450 captures, H0/H1 and three saved AX sites only
native_horizon_geometry.formula: common fraction = 50 * ||mean_horizon(x)||_F^2 / ||x||_F^2; exact orthogonal constant-slot projection
limitations: Descriptive feature geometry only; no semantic or control-risk attribution
Fixed probe, tau and slot positions cannot be causally separated using this single-probe capture
No shifted-slot comparison: it would change fixed probe/position as well as relative horizon
Results concern self_read450, not old T2340 weights
Horizon-specific effects can be arbitrarily small or large in downstream learned readout

contract.scope: four train tasks, two teachers, A28 single FM and B20 ten-step generated first-five risk
contract.parameter: execution LoRA A with compiled B held fixed; not full Writer derivative
contract.projection: right-project A cotangent onto row(A) and its orthogonal complement by QR
contract.metric: Euclidean Frobenius in the saved factor coordinates; not gauge invariant and not a capacity fraction
contract.disjointness: A28/B20/teacher episodes mutually disjoint within the diagnostic; all are original training tasks/data
contract.scope_limits: first-order train-side transfer only; no finite update, closed-loop result, legal conditional-A inference or necessity conclusion

dynamic_content_destination_witness.scope: Algebraic fixed-native/address witness, not a LIBERO measurement or full-network impossibility proof
dynamic_content_destination_witness.interpretation: Any earlier Value at e2 can be arbitrary; a zero last Value at e1 leaves the e1 conditional action zero. Transported earlier dynamic evidence can be written to e1 without changing A or repeating native.
limits: Real native features need not realize these exact orthogonal addresses.
Learning native/A can avoid this fixed-feature configuration.
No conclusion that this configuration is the observed performance bottleneck.
